source_findings: ADOPTION and QUALIFICATION define a new revision, preserve C199 consumed N01, and permit one new fixed cohort only after independent exact-lock approval.
qualification_gate binds old failure evidence, same C198 cases/order, unchanged resource limits, exact new command/environment and allowance; an old approval or old schedule cannot authorize it.
The coordinator rejects source caches before repository imports, checks complete bytes and -IBS/exact host environment, then creates an exclusive invocation receipt before entering the shared runner.
An existing invocation, schedule or result prevents a second authorized coordinator call. An exception records reconciliation-required and does not invent a zero-start result.
The shared runner invokes each slot once, stops at the first failed transaction/readback/control, and retains qualified=false until actual visual and independent result review.

prepare_inputs refuses used output/schedule paths, checks all 280 original source bindings against published C199 baseline, binds every new normative executable, and cannot produce independent approval.

inventory_host inventories actual interpreter/stdlib and overinclusive OS shared libraries with actual aliases and modes; ldd traces are dependency inspections, with dynamic initialization still an actual native gate.

Ten new protocol controls exercise original-failure mutation, old authority/schedule, missing revision/coordinator, used invocation and altered allowance rejections; they are metadata/guard controls, not native success.
The sole shared-runner change is an independently verified literal scope sentence; transaction, supervisor, store, receiving, independent expected data and tolerances are unchanged.
